scope: P-0336 life-history enrichment: historical geographical context for the independently source-proven Rökland/Alnö and Tureberg/Sollentuna endpoints, plus a bounded Lundby routing check
research_context: T-0012 batch 226: historical place-context enrichment for P-0336 Olaus Fredberg's independently source-proven life route; place records must not establish identity, residence, parentage or occupation.

interpretation: Rosenberg supplies historical environmental context for Rökland and Tureberg, whose connection to P-0336 is established by separate church-book, census and press citations. The Rökland and Rockland entries show a west-Alnö sawmill and loading-place environment but do not prove Olaus worked for either facility. Tureberg's rail setting is contextually relevant to a retired railway worker but does not prove his residence or death there. The Lundby cross-reference only supports archival routing toward Stora Lundby and leaves the birth identity and parentage unresolved.
limitations: The geographical lexicon does not name Olaus Fredberg.
Residence, migration, occupation and death are established only by the existing person-bearing citations.
No employment at Rockland's steam saw, either loading place, Tureberg station or Tureberg mill is inferred.
The Tureberg record cannot replace the family death notice or Sollentuna death book.
The Lundby cross-reference does not resolve the conflicting 1852 dates, the precise birth parish or either parent.
No-result place queries are spelling-, parish-filter- and dataset-bounded, not place or residence nulls.
No person, relationship, birth identity, parent or new residence event was created from these records.
